heading: Availability
intro: Set when and how learners can book 1:1 sessions with you.

location.heading: Meeting location
location.description: Where the video call happens when a learner books a session.
location.meetingLinkPlaceholder: https://zoom.us/j/… or your BigBlueButton room URL

weeklyHours.heading: Weekly hours
weeklyHours.description: Turn on the days you're free, and set the hours learners can book within.

overrides.heading: Time off & specific dates
overrides.addDateTitle: Add a date to block off or give custom hours
overrides.description: Block off a day, or give a specific date different hours — these override your weekly hours above.

sessionSettings.heading: Session settings
sessionSettings.description: Default session length and the scheduling rules around it — notice, buffers, and how far ahead learners can book.

sessionTypes.heading: Session types
sessionTypes.description: Optional. Offer more than one bookable length (e.g. “Quick chat” 15 min, “Deep dive” 60 min) — the learner picks one when booking. Leave empty to use the default duration above.

validation.endAfterStart: {{day}}: end time must be after start time.
validation.enableOneDay: Enable at least one day so learners can book.
validation.addMeetingLink: Add your meeting link (Zoom, BigBlueButton, or other).
